the study of jet quenching and medium modification of jet fragmentation in cold and hot dense medium.
the study of the medium-modification of jets and jet quenchings in both cold and hot nuclear medium.
the study of the modification of jet fragmentation function and jet energy loss due to the interaction with a dense medium.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a static model is sufficient for describing the jet quenching observed in the RHIC energy range.
the observed jet quenching is not due to the medium created in the initial stage, but rather to the hot matter formed in the later stage of the collision.
jet quenching is a powerful tool to probe the early time evolution of the hot matter created in relativistic heavy-ion collisions.
